evidence: 2026-09-29: driven through the Agent Vault proxy with this recipe; all three selectors matched. Sign up was pressed twice (click, then Enter): each time the fields went disabled while the request ran and came back with no message, no visible challenge and no mail to the signup address. 2026-09-30, with browser egress through the owner's tunnel on a US network: the same signup now answered that the email is already registered, so an account may exist from the earlier attempt, but no mail from Mercari ever arrived and a sign-in with the same credentials sat on the form with no message and no redirect. gotchas: A Terms of Service and Privacy Policy checkbox must be ticked; Sign up stays disabled until it is.
A cookie banner (Got it / Review details) covers the Sign up button until it is dismissed.
The password placeholder asks for at least 8 characters; no maximum was shown.
An invisible reCAPTCHA frame is on the page.

Through the Agent Vault proxy (both its own egress and a US egress), Sign up and Log in submitted with no visible answer: no error, no challenge, no redirect and no mail. A signup that looks silent may still register the email; a later signup with the same address is answered that it is already registered.
On 2026-09-30 the same silence followed with an address on the account owner's own domain (no mail to either inbox), so the email domain is not what Mercari refuses.
